prompt_en: In a home sewing corner beside a balcony door, one adult with the reference image's visible dark bob, fine fringe strands, soft facial outline and glossy lips organizes handmade beaded bracelets into tissue-lined gift boxes, creating a McBling mid-2000s pop-fashion gift-packing moment. The adult wears a candy-pink velour zip hoodie with a sparkling rhinestone heart motif, low-rise flared jeans and a rhinestone-studded belt; large hoop earrings catch the light, and a metallic silver shoulder bag hangs on the chair back. Seated upright on a stable chair with both feet on the floor, the adult steadies an open gift box at its near rim with the left hand while the right hand lowers one beaded bracelet onto the tissue inside it. Both forearms, wrists, fingers and the open box interior remain visible, with space between the hands. The worktable holds three already filled boxes, a shallow bead tray, loose ribbon, small fabric offcuts, and an unplugged hairdryer beside a tangled charger cable occupying the last clear patch. The completed boxes and the current partly filled box make the packing sequence readable. A shoulder-height compact-camera snapshot from the open doorway shows the adult, both working hands, the low waistline and flared denim legs in one environmental frame. Bright direct flash gives the rhinestones and silver bag crisp glints against soft daylight from the balcony; skin, velour pile, denim seams and creased tissue retain tangible photographic texture. The table sits beside the chair so the doorway view includes the waistband, both lower legs and the patch of floor supporting the feet. A compact flash just above the camera lights the bracelet hand and makes a short hard-edged chair-and-hoodie shadow on the nearby wall.
